title: Lease race / takeover / autocommit / expiry-at-COMMIT / ABA / restore-epoch invariants on local disposable PG (capped correctness)

workload.source: the same PG cell run as M-4a; tests named T10-07 in elp206-manager-store.spec.ts (tip has renew(..., notAfterMs))

resource_limits.deviation_from_manifest_cell: manifest isolated_cell is node 3 CPU/3 GiB + PG 1 CPU/1 GiB (4/4); this cell is node 2/2 GiB + PG 1/1 GiB (3/3) per the 3 CPU / 3 GiB run cap, so absolute ms are NOT comparable with measurements.md run1

stop_conditions: rep with exit code != 0 is reported
no production database, no restore of production data

tests.name: T10-07 refuses autocommit before any projection/checkpoint write
T10-07 validates finite lease duration and strict scope before issuing SQL
T10-07 two connections elect one holder; release/reclaim fences same-owner ABA and preserves one effect
T10-07 committed takeover rejects a prefetched old batch and never ACKs it
T10-07 expiry after writes is rejected by the deferred COMMIT fence and rolls back head plus checkpoint
T10-07 restore epoch CAS invalidates old receipts without deleting fencing or historical facts
T10-07 rejects mismatched workspace/environment/profile lease and captures it before caller mutation
T10-07 SOURCE_VERIFIED-shaped private input remains source-dark; fixture flags are not activation
